scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --external electron --outdir dist --entry-naming [name].cjs
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.prettier: prettier --write src electron-builder.config.js eslint.config.js package.json prettier.config.js tsconfig.json
